suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-8 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. HIV/AIDS is associated with a distinct spectrum of peripheral neuropathies, especially distal predominantly sensory polyneuropathy, through HIV disease mechanisms and, in some patients, treatment-related neurotoxicity. Require established HIV/AIDS and a separately diagnosed peripheral-neuropathy phenotype. Distinguish HIV-related disease mechanisms from antiretroviral neurotoxicity and preserve diabetes, alcohol, nutritional deficiency, chemotherapy, compressive neuropathy, opportunistic infection, and other neurologic causes. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
